indonesia.title: Flag of Indonesia

colors.note: Represents courage and the blood of independence heroes
Symbolizes purity and the spiritual life of the nation

desc: - Two equal horizontal bands, red above white, derived from the 13th-century Majapahit Empire flag
- The simplest design among sovereign flags, representing the duality of body and spirit
trivia:
- The red and white colours come from the Majapahit Empire (1293–1527), one of the largest maritime empires
- The simplicity of Indonesia's flag makes it distinctive — just two horizontal stripes
- Indonesia's flag is nearly identical to Monaco's and the Polish flag, differing only in proportions
